name: draw
description: Headless board SDK for quick notes and freehand drawings, like Google Keep. Primary surface is a framework agnostic board and card core (createBoard/loadBoard, note and drawing cards, pin/archive/reorder ops, JSON serialization, query and stats) plus a portable Excalidraw compatible drawing scene interchange with no heavy renderer dependency. An optional React entry point (@hasna/draw/react) ships board, card, and freehand draw surface components. A `draw` CLI performs headless board edits and Excalidraw export over files. MCP and HTTP serve and Postgres persistence are optional scaffolding not yet shipped in this v1.
